title: fix: session previews leak Markdown link markup around nested brackets
body:
Closes #166643

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: session previews show raw Markdown link syntax, or lose the rest of the message, when a link label contains brackets or a link URL contains parentheses.

## User Impact

User impact: session list previews, sidebar narration, and mention excerpts show `Read the Report [Q3] and then deploy.` instead of `[Report [Q3]](https://...` cut off at the preview limit, and links to URLs such as `report_(Q3)` or `report\)Q3` no longer leave `)` or `Q3)` behind.

## Why This Change Was Made

`flattenMarkdownToPlainText` (`packages/normalization-core/src/markdown-plain-text.ts`) matched links with `\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)`, which stops at the first `]` and the first `)`. A nested label never matched, so the whole link stayed and its long URL used up the preview budget. A balanced or escaped `)` in the URL ended the match early and left the rest of the URL in the text.

The link step now pairs each `[` with its balanced `]`, skipping backslash escapes, and keeps only the label of each `[label](destination)` or `![label](destination)`. After the label it reads the destination the way CommonMark defines it: a bare destination with balanced parentheses, or `<...>`, then an optional `"..."`, `'...'`, or `(...)` title, then `)`. Parentheses inside a quoted title no longer count toward the destination, so `[docs](url "Docs (v2")` flattens to `docs` and the prose after it stays. Brackets inside a destination or title are skipped while labels are paired, so they never close a label: `[![build](badge[.svg)](ci)` and `[![build](badge.svg "Build [main")](ci)` flatten to `build`, as they did on `main`. Only ASCII spaces and control characters end a bare destination, and only ASCII whitespace separates the destination from its title, as CommonMark defines them, so a URL holding a non-breaking space (U+00A0) still flattens: `[docs](https://example.com/a b)` becomes `docs`, as on `main`. The scan is iterative and linear, so deeply nested or unbalanced input cannot exhaust the stack or go quadratic. The other flattening steps are unchanged.

## Evidence

Real Gateway session previews, base `f98d079cb9d` vs head `1cb13fb92a8`. `openclaw gateway run` on loopback with an isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, a local OpenAI-compatible stub model on `127.0.0.1` that replies with the text it was sent, and no credentials. One `chat.send` per session, then `sessions.list {"includeLastMessage": true}`. The preview is the assistant reply's `lastMessagePreview`, so it went through the transcript tail reader and the display projection. `dist/build-info.json` matched the commit for each run.

| Case (assistant reply) | Base `lastMessagePreview` | Head `lastMessagePreview` |
|---|---|---|
| Nested label: `Read the [Report [Q3]](https://example.com/xxx…200 x…) and then deploy.` | `Read the [Report [Q3]](https://example.com/xxxx…xxx...` (cut at the 240-char limit, trailing prose lost) | `Read the Report [Q3] and then deploy.` |
| Balanced parens: `Read the [report](https://example.com/report_(Q3)) and then deploy.` | `Read the report) and then deploy.` | `Read the report and then deploy.` |
| Escaped paren: `Read the [report](https://example.com/report\)Q3) and then deploy.` | `Read the reportQ3) and then deploy.` | `Read the report and then deploy.` |
| Quoted title with `(`: `See [docs](https://example.com/docs "Docs (v2") and [guide](https://example.com/guide) now.` | `See docs and guide now.` | `See docs and guide now.` |
| Angle destination: `Open [spec](<https://example.com/a (b>) and read it today.` | `Open spec and read it today.` | `Open spec and read it today.` |
| Linked image, `[` in destination: `Badge [![build](https://example.com/badge[.svg)](https://ci.example.com) is green.` | `Badge build is green.` | `Badge build is green.` |
| Linked image, `[` in title: `Badge [![build](https://example.com/badge.svg "Build [main")](https://ci.example.com) is green.` | `Badge build is green.` | `Badge build is green.` |

The last four rows match base on purpose. The quoted-title and angle-bracket rows are cases the first revision of this PR regressed and `a43f86e42fd` restored. The two linked-image rows are the review's second finding: `a43f86e42fd` flattened them to `Badge [build](https://ci.example.com) is green.`, and `1cb13fb92a8` restores the base output. The table was not rerun for `0140c318d75`, whose only change is the U+00A0 handling below.

- `packages/normalization-core/src/markdown-plain-text.test.ts` covers nested labels, balanced and escaped destination parentheses, images, quoted and parenthesized titles (including `"Docs (v2"`), angle-bracket destinations, an unclosed destination, an empty label, linked images with `[` in the destination or title, and 20,000 nested links. On `main` (`f98d079cb9d`) the original cases fail 6 of 16, for example `Read the report)) and then deploy.`. The quoted-title test failed on the first revision with `See docs now` (the `and [guide](...)` text was dropped). The two linked-image tests failed on `a43f86e42fd` with `Badge [build](https://ci.example.com) ok`. Two tests for a non-breaking space in a bare destination, alone and inside parentheses, failed on `1cb13fb92a8` with `Read [docs](https://example.com/a b) now`. With the fix, 23/23 pass.
- `src/gateway/session-display-projection.test.ts` adds the issue's three cases at the projection boundary, with the 240-character URL and trailing prose. On `main` 3 of 8 fail. With the fix, 8/8 pass.
- Touched area: all `normalization-core` tests plus every test file that imports the flattener's callers (`session-display-projection`, `session-utils.fs`, `ui/src/components/markdown*`, `chat-transcript-feed`), 46 files and 952 tests, passed on `a43f86e42fd` with `pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1`. On `1cb13fb92a8`, `normalization-core`, `session-display-projection`, and `session-utils.fs` (27 files) pass except one `session-utils.fs` transcript-path test that fails the same way on `main` on macOS (`/var` vs `/private/var` temp path).
- On `0140c318d75`, all 25 `normalization-core` test files (336 tests) and `session-display-projection` (8 tests) pass. Changed-test wall time with `pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1`: `markdown-plain-text.test.ts` 2.2 s (vitest 0.8 s), `session-display-projection.test.ts` 2.6 s (vitest 1.0 s). CI on the previous head `1cb13fb92a8` ran 203 check runs for 33,484 job-seconds in total, the longest 707 s, with no failures.
- 200,000-character adversarial inputs (runs of `[`, `[a](`, `](`, and unterminated titles) flatten in 4 to 14 ms each on `1cb13fb92a8`.
- `oxfmt --check`, `oxlint`, `tsc --noEmit -p packages/normalization-core`, and `git diff --check` are clean on the changed files, and `pnpm tsgo:core` passes on `0140c318d75`.

Not verified: the Control UI rendering of a real session list. The `lastMessagePreview` values above are the field the Control UI sidebar and session rows read.

AI disclosure: this PR was written with an AI tool (Claude Code, an AI agent). The agent reproduced the issue with the tests above, wrote the tests and the fix, ran the checks listed here (`pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1`, `pnpm tsgo:core`, `oxfmt --check`, `oxlint`, `tsc --noEmit`, `git diff --check`), and ran the base-vs-head Gateway comparison (`openclaw gateway run`, `openclaw gateway call chat.send`, `openclaw gateway call sessions.list`). A second model reviewed the diff, and the label scan was made iterative after it showed recursion could overflow the stack.
